description: This file defines the DonateInvestListener class, which handles investment events related to donations within the Goteo application. It manages the processes for successful and failed donation investments, including logging, notifications, redirections, and updating investment details.

classes.name: DonateInvestListener
classes.description: Event listener class that handles donation-related investment success and failure events, performing logging, notifications, redirection, and data updates.

methods.name: onInvestFailed
methods.description: Handles failed donation investments by logging the failure, updating the invest record, creating admin feed entries, and redirecting the user to the payment page for retry.

methods.name: onInvestSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful donation investments by updating the investment status, sending thank-you emails, creating admin and public feed entries, and redirecting the user to their donation page.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the event constants to the handler methods for subscribing to relevant investment events.
